$comment: Operational risk register. Seeded ONLY from risks already documented in this repository (each entry cites its source file and an anchor string that scripts/compliance/check-risk-register.mjs verifies). No likelihood or impact score exists in those sources, so every entry is unscored; owners and review dates are for the company to set. Not an assessment, not evidence of a performed review, makes no compliance claim.

scoring.status: PROPOSED, not approved (risk-assessment.md lists the scoring method as an open gap)
scoring.method: score = likelihood x impact, both integers 1-5; null = not yet scored

review.basis: docs/compliance/SOC2_READINESS.md lists a quarterly review cadence
review.rule: A risk is stale when today > last_reviewed + (review_interval_days or default_interval_days). last_reviewed = null means never reviewed.

risks.title: Cross-tenant data read or write
risks.description: A user reaches another tenant's data through any table (information disclosure / tampering).

controls.description: RLS scoped by get_account_owner_id()
RLS audit script
pgTAP CI job is continue-on-error; baseline replay issue noted in supabase/tests/README.md

risks.title: Forged provider webhook
risks.description: An attacker sends a forged webhook to a *-webhook / *-callback edge function (spoofing).

controls.description: Signature checks on webhook functions
Functions marked "none detected" in WEBHOOKS.md need review; replay protection is not uniform

risks.title: Unauthenticated edge-function abuse
risks.description: Functions with verify_jwt=false are abused (spoofing, denial of service).

controls.description: Cron/API-key/signature gates, rate limits, function-matrix ratchet in CI
config.toml lists fewer verify_jwt=false functions than the matrix reports; reconcile

risks.title: Privilege escalation (staff / owner / technician)
risks.description: A user obtains a role they should not have through routes or RPCs.

controls.description: Route guards, RLS, staff RPC checks, MFA (AAL2) when enrolled
Confirm every privileged RPC checks the role server-side, not only in the UI

risks.title: Secret leakage
risks.description: Secrets leak through the repository, logs or the client bundle.

controls.description: gitleaks in security.yml
Rotation and leak response in RUNBOOK.md section 7
Rotation cadence undecided

risks.title: Provider token theft or misuse
risks.description: Stored accounting, ads, bank or calendar tokens are stolen or misused.

controls.description: Encrypted token storage (*_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY) and OAuth state secrets
Key rotation requires a re-encryption plan

risks.title: Prompt injection and data exfiltration through AI
risks.description: Voice agent, interpreter or Ask Vireek is manipulated into leaking or altering data.

controls.description: Grounded prompts and tool gating; DPIA
Per-tool authorization review for agent tools

risks.title: Card data exposure in pay-by-phone
risks.description: Card details captured by phone are exposed (information disclosure).

controls.description: Recording paused and verified, fail closed
Not a PCI attestation (as stated in the threat model)

risks.title: Malicious input to edge functions
risks.description: Insufficient input validation allows tampering through function bodies.

controls.description: Mostly manual validation; schema validation in a few functions
Increase schema validation coverage (matrix "No validation detected")

risks.title: Supply-chain compromise
risks.description: A malicious dependency or GitHub Action is introduced.

controls.description: npm audit, CodeQL, weekly Dependabot
Pin and review action versions

risks.title: Repudiation of admin and data changes
risks.description: Admin or data changes cannot be attributed.

controls.description: audit_log without client write policy; flag audit
Platform log retention undefined

risks.title: Availability and cost abuse (AI, SMS, telephony)
risks.description: Abuse of metered services causes outage or runaway cost.

controls.description: Rate limits, AI usage logs, capacity guard
Document budgets per provider

risks.title: Over-broad Chrome extension
risks.description: The extension reads more than disclosed (information disclosure).

controls.description: Tokens only in the service worker; only origin and path stored
Content script runs on all http(s) pages; keep the disclosure accurate

risks.title: Misuse of privileged Vireek-staff access
risks.description: Staff impersonate, export or bulk-read customer data without a business reason.

controls.description: Append-only staff audit trail and impersonation sessions
Staff insider-risk alert rules and quarterly access review (added in this change set; not yet scheduled or reviewed)
No notification channel or staff UI for alerts; ethics channel designed but not live (docs/compliance/ethics-channel.md); service-role and provider-console access is outside the logs

risks.title: Erasure incomplete across tables
risks.description: Full-account erasure covers a small owned-table list while many more tables hold a user_id; uncovered data may survive deletion.

controls.description: Erasure coverage check and baseline (exist in the repo; effectiveness not re-verified)
Gap list proposes generating the owned-table list from the schema

risks.title: No provider-side erasure
risks.description: Vapi, Twilio, ElevenLabs and Resend copies (recordings, logs, cloned voices) are not removed on erasure.

controls.description: Per-provider erasure adapters with retry queue and proof record (proposed in the gap list)

risks.title: Public sub-processor list incomplete
risks.description: The public sub-processor page omits providers that the code calls.

controls.description: Generator with --check mode
Classify core vs customer-optional providers and update the list; do not wire --check into CI until fixed

risks.title: Recording consent logic limited to US area codes
risks.description: Call-recording consent is keyed to the caller number and US area codes only; no DE/EU/UK/CA/AU logic.

controls.description: Region/profile resolver by business location (gap list)

risks.title: Data residency not enforced
risks.description: Regions other than US are not enforceable; provider-hosted recordings and the LLM chain are not region-pinned.

controls.description: Residency decision record
Migration and enforcement probe; region-pinning of provider data (ADR phases 1-2)

risks.title: Contracts, lawful bases and legal texts not counsel-reviewed
risks.description: Contracting entity, DPA and SCC annexes, AI Act roles and wording, retention periods, Impressum and messaging-consent rules are open legal items.

controls.description: Counsel review of items L1-L12 in the gap list

risks.title: Public security claims ahead of evidence
risks.description: Marketing copy suggests SOC 2 readiness or end-to-end encryption while the repository records no SOC 2 report and the claim register does not support it (misrepresentation risk).

controls.description: Claims register and drift check
Replace the copy flagged in F1 and in NEEDS_HUMAN item 12

risks.title: Disaster-recovery data readable by all tenants
risks.description: DR tables are readable by all authenticated tenants and consumed by src/lib/dataGovernance.ts; needs a design decision.

controls.description: Staff-only access plus a sanitised status RPC (not auto-fixed to avoid breaking the DR health UI)

risks.title: Possible anon/PUBLIC execute on log_audit_event
risks.description: The default function grant may let anon execute log_audit_event; verification query pending.

controls.description: Cross-tenant write guard on log_audit_event()
Verify grants in production; revoke only after confirming no anon flow depends on it

risks.title: Demo account with a known password
risks.description: A migration creates a demo account with a known password; high impact if present in production.

controls.description: Verify in production; remove through a reviewed procedure

risks.title: MFA not enforced for staff and tenant admins
risks.description: MFA is opt-in and not enforced for Vireek staff or tenant owners/admins.

source.anchor: MFA is opt-in; it is not enforced for Vireek staff

controls.description: AAL2 required for step-up on sensitive actions when MFA is enrolled
Enforce MFA for staff and workforce accounts (policy gap in access-control.md)

risks.title: No measured recovery objectives or restore-drill evidence
risks.description: RPO/RTO targets, PITR retention, restore owner and drill evidence are not recorded.

source.anchor: Measured RPO/RTO targets and drill evidence location

controls.description: Backup and restore runbook sections
Measure targets; run and record a restore drill

risks.title: No business-continuity plan
risks.description: Critical-service list, continuity plan and communication tree are not defined.

source.anchor: Continuity plan, critical-service list, communication tree

controls.description: Write and test the plan

risks.title: Vendor risk not assessed
risks.description: DPA status per provider, vendor reviews and collection of provider assurance reports are missing.

source.anchor: DPA status per provider and annual review process

controls.description: Public /subprocessors and /dpa pages exist; subprocessor generator
Per-vendor review register and DPA tracking

risks.title: Incident response not operational
risks.description: No adopted severity targets, on-call roster, or owner for breach-notification decisions.

source.anchor: Breach-notification decision owner and legal obligations

controls.description: Incident process in RUNBOOK.md section 6
Adopt targets and roster; name the breach-notification decision owner

risks.title: Platform logging and alerting undefined
risks.description: Platform log retention/export, alert thresholds and recipients are not defined.

source.anchor: Platform log retention/export and alert thresholds and recipients

controls.description: Alert routing code exists for voice SLIs (Slack/PagerDuty webhooks optional)
Define retention, thresholds and recipients

risks.title: No vulnerability-remediation targets or third-party penetration test
risks.description: Severity-based remediation times and a pen-test schedule are not defined; no penetration-test report exists.

source.anchor: Remediation time targets by severity; pentest schedule

controls.description: CodeQL, Dependabot, npm audit in CI
Set remediation targets; commission a third-party penetration test

related_sources.anchor: Penetration test by a third party

risks.title: Offboarding not covering all systems
risks.description: The onboarding/offboarding checklist does not yet cover GitHub, hosting, Supabase, Stripe, Twilio, Vapi, Firebase and shared secrets.

controls.description: Complete checklist; tie it to the quarterly access review (docs/compliance/insider-risk-monitoring.md)

risks.title: Credentials possibly exposed in the archive or in chats
risks.description: A .env file travelled inside the ZIP, and credentials may have been pasted into chats, patches or docs.

controls.description: gitleaks configuration
Check git history, rotate anything in doubt, store secrets only in secret managers (NEEDS_HUMAN items 5-7)

risks.title: Migration history with duplicate versions
risks.description: Duplicate migration versions make a database push unsafe until cleaned up and rehearsed.

controls.description: Migration rehearsal workflow
Review the cleanup, rehearse on staging, then push (NEEDS_HUMAN item 8)

risks.title: Change control not enforced
risks.description: Branch protection and required code-owner reviews are not enabled; CODEOWNERS holds placeholders.

source.anchor: enable branch protection and required reviews

controls.description: CODEOWNERS file exists (placeholders unassigned)
Enable branch protection; replace @OWNER_* placeholders

risks.title: No accountable owners for risk areas
risks.description: Every area in docs/OWNERS.md is unassigned; risks, runbooks and reviews have no named person.

controls.description: Warn-only owners check in CI
Assign owners and run the check with --strict on release branches
